title: Gas Monitoring Input
description: Standardized input contract for a gas-test/AGT reading. Field names mirror PTWPermit.gasReadings and CargoHandlingGasPoint (src/types/lng.ts), and thresholds mirror the universal gate constants in src/data/ptwGasSafetyRules.ts. Reference-only for next-phase RBAC/PTW runtime wiring — does not replace validatePTWGasSafety()/checkUniversalGasBands() or the periodic Zone AGT register in src/data/01_raw_docs/gasTestingLogData.ts (a separate, permit-independent domain — see that file's DOMAIN NOTE).

tagId.description: Measurement point, e.g. T-201..T-204 (Unloading Skid), VAP-101..106

hgPpm.description: Optional; captured for audit only, no numeric SSHQE ceiling confirmed

permitRefNo.description: Optional; links a permit-scoped reading back to its PTWPermit. Absent for the independent periodic Zone AGT register.
